patterns_found.name: Change of Character
patterns_found.evidence: Prior bullish market structure with higher highs up to approximately 1845. Recent price action rejecting higher prices and forming lower highs from the 1845 area. Current price at 1810 declining toward the 1790-1800 support zone.

patterns_found.name: Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three peaks visible in recent price action: left shoulder around 1830, head around 1845, and right shoulder forming around 1840. Price is declining from the right shoulder toward the neckline area near 1800.

limitations: Latest candle may still be forming
